title: The Ladyzhenskaya-Prodi-Serrin Conditions and the Search for Extreme Behavior in 3D Navier-Stokes Flows
summary: In this investigation, we conduct a systematic computational search for potential singularities in 3D Navier-Stokes flows on a periodic domain $Ω$ based on the Ladyzhenskaya-Prodi-Serrin conditions. They assert that for a solution $\mathbf{u}(t)$ of the Navier-Stokes system to be regular on an interval $[0,T]$, the integral $\int_{0}^T \|\mathbf{u}(t)\|_{L^q}^p\,dt$, where $2/p+3/q=1,\;q>3$, and the expression $\sup_{t \in [0,T]} \|\mathbf{u}(t)\|_{L^3}$ must be bounded.
